OFMA is an Italian company that mainly works for the aerospace and defense fields. It has been founded in 1970 by Franco Olivero as a small mechanic's workshop, and now with the new Managing Director Alessandro Olivero, it has become a company of 27 employees in a headquarter of 6000 meters squared. OFMA designs, produces, assembles, and tests very high precision mechanical parts participating in different space programs as subcontractor.
OFMA can give its effort to the entire chain, from the design through the production, special processes, assembly, and quality testing. OFMA has realized structural parts for different programs, from the International Space Station with Harmony, Tranquillity, Cygnus, and Orion up to satellites for the Solar System like Cosmo Skymed, Bepi Colombo and the Galileo Constellation. OFMA also work for the aeronautics field producing and assembling flying parts for different aircraft and helicopters (e.g. A380, A320, EFA, M346, F7X, P180, C-27J, and many others).
OFMA well tested production chain ensure low costs, short times and high quality, which are key asset for every aerospace project.
The wide certified machining park which counts 15 milling machines without taking into account EDM and lathes and the agreement with its direct suppliers ensure OFMA the higher level of reliability. 
The air-conditioned CNCs allow OFMA to produce honey comb panels and working carbon fiber up to dimensions of (6000 x 3000 x 1500)mm, (236 x 118 x 59)inches. Due to its direct linked suppliers OFMA can provide to the Customer the final package including NDT, special processes and vibration tests.

LUNEX Stichting was founded in 2001 to promote space resarch and exploration.
LUNEX developed number of research programmes since 2003 in collaboration with universities (including Amsterdam, Leiden, TU Delft) and companies, and since 2019 research activities in applying AI to space data , in particular Earth Observations.
LUNEX joined in 2022 the EuroSpaceHub consortium with other universities (Vilnius, ISU, Madrid) and companies
to train space researchers and entrepreneurs.

We describe research and events highlights from ILEWG LUNEX EuroMoonMars Earth Space Innovation EMMESI academy, EuroSpaceHub partners contributing to MoonMars and space missions, Field Research, Astronautics and Entrepreneurship. Organisation of Conferences and Community Events: As per its terms of reference ILEWG LUNEX EMMESI has co-organised sessions (O) , workshops (W), field work cam paigns (F), committees meetings (C), community events (E), panels (P) and sessions (S) at International Conferences, and presented reports and talks (T) and Posters/Interactive presentations (IP) there, supported by students YLE Young Explorers grants (Y). Missions, Data, Instruments, Field Work, Astronauts: EuroMoonMars is an ILEWG programme [1-235] in collaboration with space agencies, academia, universities and re search institutions and industries. The programme includes research activities supporting Moon and Mars Missions for data analysis, instruments tests and development, field tests in MoonMars analogue, pilot projects, training and hands-on workshops, technical visits and outreach activities. Support for Moon, Mars and Space Missions. Data analysis, AI and Machine Learning for Space: we have developed with collaborators advanced analysis of space and astronomy data at EMMESI academy. Sample analysis: we analysed various samples including meteorites from Moon, Mars, asteroids, and analogue field samples from campaigns (Vulcano, Etna, Hawaii HI-SEAS) using spectrometry, hyperspectral imaging and Raman . LUNEX also participates in collaboration with TU Delft in the study of ice, minerals and organics mixture relevant for Moon, Mars and icy Moons. Payload development: we have developed a test bench for sample analysis and adapted an Hyperspectral camerafor telescopic observations . Space Photonics Labin collaboration with Fotonika Latvia, a shoebox module for extracting organics from icy Moons. LUNEX ExoGeoLab lander is currently adapted with shoebox instruments for supporting future missions . Cubesats for education, EarthMoonMars exploration: LUNEX EMMESI has initiated the development of universi ty education cubesats with the support of Leiden University, Delft TU, In Holland, ESA BIC.Field work and testing of instruments and protocols: EuroMoonMars field campaigns were organised in specific locations of technical, scientific and exploration interest. EuroMoonMars Analogue astronauts simulations have been organised since 2009 in collaboration with ESA, NASA, European and US universities a programme of data analysis, instrumentation tests, field work and analog missions for students and researchers in different locations worldwide, including Utah MDRS, IMA Hawaii HI-SEAs, Iceland, Etna/ Vulcano Italy, Atacama, AATC Poland, ESTEC Netherlands, Eifel Germany, etc… ExoSpaceHab Xpress (ESH-X) is an innovative portable lunar base simulator designed for education, analog missions and public outreach. This habitat has been funded by Euro pean consortium EuroSpaceHub and its partner LUNEX EuroMoonMars. ESH-X lab-hab module is used to test experiments and investigations for Artemis programme. Telespazio Ibérica (Spain) belongs to Telespazio Group, European leader in satellite technology services and geoinformation applications. The company, based in Madrid, currently counts on 150 employees distributed among its premises in Madrid, Barcelona, Vigo and Fuerteventura. Ownership: Telespazio SpA (100%). Telespazio SpA is a JointVenture between Leonardo (67%) and Thales (33%).Our turnover in 2023 has been of 10,3M�.
Telespazio Ibérica, which was originally focused on Cartography production, Remote Sensing and Geographic Information Systems; currently develops its activities in Spain and Portugal through its Geo Information, SATCOM and Satellite Services Operations Lines of Business, playing an important role in E-GNSS User Services in all applications domains, both in EGNOS & Galileo, integrated in ESSP and Spaceopal Teams, both at Torrejón de Ardoz premises in Madrid.
A global approach to asset management from the geospatial point of view, allows Telespazio Ibérica to offer services covering the entire life cycle from the generation of the cartographic data using leading edge technology, to information systems development combining GIS with other corporate systems, telecommunications, and mobile devices.
We have become the centre of competence (CoC) of Telespazio Group since 2016 in the fields of cartography production, design and implementation of GIS, requirement analysis, processes definition and maintenance of the huge data volumes usually associated with complex corporate systems. From the Spanish headquarters of the company, all types of cartographic projects are addressed to Spain, other European Countries and other international destinations (especially in LATAM). Among the different projects that are produced from our CoC, the following should be highlighted: 3D urban cartography, satellite 2D cartography, Land Cover / Land Use (LCLU) and other thematic cartographies for European projects (outstanding role in COPERNICUS and in particular in Copernicus Land, Emergency and Security services), Rapid Mapping, Defence-MGCP cartography, remote sensing, etc.
Telespazio Ibérica addresses its portfolio to both public and private sectors, offering specific solutions to technology demanding markets such as Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications, Public administrations, Defence, Transport, Emergencies, Insurance or Banking sectors.
